changes.text: 李鸿章的淮军刚到上海时，西方人看到他们衣帽粗陋，暗中嘲笑。李鸿章对身边的人说「軍之良窳，豈在服制耶」，意思是：军队好坏，难道在于穿什么吗？这句反问是对嘲笑的回应。他接着说，等对方见识了淮军大将的旗鼓，自然会有定论。后来欧美人看到淮军将校勇敢、纪律严整，都改了态度，常胜军也开始服从李鸿章的调度。

When Li Hongzhang's Huai Army first arrived in Shanghai, Westerners laughed behind their hands at the soldiers' rough clothes and caps. Li Hongzhang asked the men around him, in effect, whether an army's quality was to be judged by its uniforms. The rhetorical question was his reply to the mockery. Let them see the banners and drums of our generals, he went on, and they will reach their own verdict. In time the Europeans and Americans saw how brave the Huai officers were and how strict their discipline, and their attitude changed. The Ever-Victorious Army, too, began to accept Li Hongzhang's command.
华尔死后，继任统领白齐文向上海道台杨坊勒索巨额军资，没有得手，就殴打杨坊，抢走四万两银子。李鸿章大怒，与英国领事交涉，撤掉白齐文，改由英国将官戈登代领常胜军。那是同治二年二月。也就是说，戈登是在李鸿章与英方交涉之后，才接手这支队伍的。

After Ward's death, his successor, Burgevine, demanded an enormous sum for military funds from Yang Fang, the circuit intendant, or daotai, of Shanghai. When the money did not come, Burgevine beat Yang Fang and carried off forty thousand taels of silver. Li Hongzhang was furious. He took the matter up with the British consul, had Burgevine removed, and put a British officer, Gordon, in command of the Ever-Victorious Army in his place. That was the second month of the same year. Gordon, in other words, took over the force only after Li Hongzhang had negotiated with the British.
城门开了，事情却没有结束。这八人的部下还有十几万人留在城中，梁启超形容为「聲勢洶洶」，意思是来势汹汹、气势逼人。程学启先前许过他们总兵、副将等官职，这时八人「求如約」，要求按约兑现。降约的前半段，是降将开门、献首级；现在轮到许诺的一方了。

The gates were open, but the matter was not closed. More than a hundred thousand of these eight men's troops were still inside the city, a force Liang describes as menacing, pressing and full of threat. Cheng Xueqi had earlier promised the eight posts such as brigade general and deputy general, and now they asked that the agreement be honoured. The defectors had done their part: they had opened the gates and handed over a head. It was now the turn of the side that had made the promises.

现在回到戈登。八人投降时，他正是阳澄湖降约的保人。梁启超写他「聞鴻章之食言也，大怒」：听说李鸿章不守诺言，戈登勃然大怒，想杀李鸿章抵罪，「自攜短銃以覓之」，亲自带着短枪去找李鸿章。「鴻章避之，不敢歸營」，李鸿章躲开了，不敢回营。几天后，戈登的怒气渐渐消了，这才作罢。梁启超在按语中评论说，李鸿章因此有愧于德：杀降违背公理，负约食言，欺骗戈登、辜负朋友；戈登如此痛恨，也在情理之中。他承认李鸿章或许是鉴于苗沛霖、李世忠的旧事，有不得已之处，但随即说，从这件事也可以看出李鸿章平生喜欢用小聪明、小手段。

Now return to Gordon. When the eight surrendered, he had been the guarantor of the pact made on Yangcheng Lake. Liang writes, in effect, that when Gordon heard Li Hongzhang had broken his word, he was enraged. Gordon wanted to kill Li Hongzhang to make him pay, and went looking for him with a pistol himself. Li Hongzhang kept out of his way and dared not return to camp. After a few days Gordon's anger slowly cooled, and he let the matter drop. In a note of his own, Liang judges that Li Hongzhang fell short in virtue here: killing men who had surrendered violated public principle, going back on the agreement broke his word, and deceiving Gordon wronged a friend; Gordon's bitter fury, he says, was only fitting. He grants that Li Hongzhang may have had the earlier cases of Miao Peilin and Li Shizhong in mind, and may have acted under some real compulsion, but concludes that the episode also shows Li Hongzhang's lifelong fondness for petty cleverness and small tricks.
第三层是程学启的理由。十几万部众、「聲勢洶洶」、「狼子野心」，书中给出的是一笔控制风险的账。梁启超在按语里还说，李鸿章或许是鉴于苗沛霖、李世忠的旧事，有不得已之处；但同一句里他也说，从这件事可见李鸿章平生好用小聪明、小手段。

The third layer is Cheng Xueqi's reasoning. More than a hundred thousand troops, a menacing presence, men he judged wolf cubs at heart: what the book sets out is a calculation about controlling risk. In his note Liang also says that Li Hongzhang may have had the earlier cases of Miao Peilin and Li Shizhong in mind and acted under some real compulsion; but in the same sentence he says the episode shows Li Hongzhang's lifelong fondness for petty cleverness and small tricks.
代价也分两笔。眼前那笔很清楚：苏州到手，李鸿章加衔。长远那笔，本文依据的记载只涉及几件事：李鸿章躲了几天，戈登怒气消退，常胜军之后仍与淮军并肩作战。后来的合作也不能证明这一步做对了，只能说明这道裂痕没有让双方当场决裂。如果承诺的风险真的太大，本文提出两种可能的做法：许诺之前先请统帅定好权限，反悔之前先和保人商量。这两种做法都是本文的假设。

The costs fall into two accounts. The immediate one is plain: Suzhou was taken and Li Hongzhang received a new title. Of the longer account, the material this article draws on mentions only a few things: Li Hongzhang stayed out of sight for a few days, Gordon's anger subsided, and the Ever-Victorious Army went on fighting beside the Huai Army. Their later cooperation does not prove the decision was right; it shows only that the rift did not break them apart on the spot. If honouring the promise really carried too great a risk, this article suggests two other courses: before promising, agree with the commander-in-chief on the limits of what may be offered; before going back on the promise, consult the guarantor. Both are this article's own hypotheses.
本文只依据梁启超《李鸿章传》一部书。这部书以李鸿章为中心，降将一方和戈登本人的说法都没有进入证据。许诺的内容有两种说法：湖上订约时是“二品之赏”，城破后降将要求兑现的是“总兵副将等职”，本文无法判断两者的关系。十几万部众、一千多余党等数字，也都只出自这一处记载。

This article rests on a single book, Liang Qichao's biography of Li Hongzhang. The book centres on Li Hongzhang; neither the defectors' version nor Gordon's own account is among the evidence. The promise is also described in two ways: at the lake it was rewards of the second rank, while after the city fell the defectors asked for posts such as brigade general and deputy general. This article cannot determine how the two relate. The figures of more than a hundred thousand troops and more than a thousand followers killed likewise come from this one account alone.

dispositions.rationale: 英文去掉引号，把李鸿章的反问改为 in effect 转述，避免冒充原话；中文原引语逐字有据，未改。
删去“小船上的第三个人”的说法。乘船去阳澄湖的只有程学启和戈登。现改为戈登是阳澄湖降约的保人，中英同步。

evidence.quote: 學啟與戈登親乘輕舸造城北之陽澄湖
先是八酋之降也，戈登實爲保人

dispositions.rationale: 按梁启超“虽……而……”的句式，补出他按语的落点：从这件事可见李鸿章平生好用小智小术。中英同步。

evidence.quote: 而文忠生平好用小智小術，亦可以見其概矣

dispositions.rationale: 在“有不得已之处”之后，补上同一句里对李鸿章“好用小智小术”的批评，避免只转述让步的一半。中英同步。

evidence.quote: 雖彼鑒於苗沛霖、李世忠故事，其個或有所大不得已者存，而文忠生平好用小智小術

dispositions.rationale: 删去“只交出一个首级、李秀成也走了”这句暗示性提示，以及“本文不把这一点当作杀降的理由”这句审核式说明。证据给出的理由只有程学启的判断。中英同步。

evidence.quote: 學啟細察此八人，謂狼子野心，恐後不可制。乃與李鴻章密謀

dispositions.rationale: 把“书中只留下片段”改为“本文依据的记载只涉及几件事”，不再断言完整来源写了什么、没写什么。中英同步。
